code.text: CHEM
COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild anemia. There is elevated D-dimer, ferritin, INR, and mild CRP, suggesting significant inflammation and coagulopathy. Mildly elevated monocytes and basophils are noted. Electrolytes and renal/liver function are within normal limits. Findings are consistent with acute systemic inflammation, possible infection, and risk of thrombotic complications; clinical correlation and urgent evaluation are recommended.
